name: Eleanor Fortworth
original_name: エレノア・フォートワース
source: Eleanor is a childhood friend of Cliff and Shilphy, and is a knight who guards Leticia. She is good at swordsmanship, and she regrets that Cliff abandoned the swordsmanship. She is a daughter of a dressmaker, and she is also good at sewing.
